# Welcome to PS50008A {background-color="#275882"}

## Research Methods & Experimental Design {.center}

Term 2 | Spring 2026

---

## What is This Module About?

::: {.objectives-box}
**You will learn to:**

- **Design** experiments that can answer your questions
- **Analyse** data using R
- **Interpret** results appropriately
- **Report** findings in professional APA format
:::

---

## Why Research Methods?

Psychology is a **science**.

To make claims about human behaviour, we need:

- Systematic observation
- Controlled experiments
- Statistical analysis
- Peer review

This module teaches you the **tools** to do this.

---

# DataLab {background-color="#275882"}

## Thursday: Your First Session

::: {.callout-important}
## No Lecture This Week
Your first contact is **Thursday's lab session** (10:00-12:00).

There is no Monday lecture in Week 11.
:::

---

## What Is DataLab?

A series of **6 cognitive task stations** where you:

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Measure reaction times
- Test your memory
- Estimate time and distances
- Test your "sixth sense"
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Explore randomness
- Assess your own abilities
- Work in pairs
- Record data in Qualtrics
:::
::::

---

## Why DataLab?

The data you generate becomes our **teaching dataset**.

When we learn about:

| Topic | Your Data |
|-------|-----------|
| Distributions | Your reaction times |
| t-tests | Lab A vs Lab B |
| Correlations | Personality × performance |
| Pre-post designs | Mood before vs after |

...we use [**your**]{.inverse-box} data, not abstract examples.

---

## The 6 Stations

::: {.step-1}
**1. Reflex Test** — How fast can you catch a falling ruler?
:::

::: {.step-2}
**2. Mind Palace** — How many words survive a distraction task?
:::

::: {.step-3}
**3. Time Warp** — How accurate is your internal clock?
:::

---

## The 6 Stations (continued)

::: {.step-1}
**4. Sixth Sense** — Can you detect when someone is watching you?
:::

::: {.step-2}
**5. Lady Luck** — How "random" can humans be?
:::

::: {.step-3}
**6. Frontal Lob** — How well do you know your own throwing ability?
:::

---

## The Pre-Post Design

We'll measure your mood, energy, and stress **twice**:

- **Part 1**: Before the stations begin
- **Part 2**: After all stations are complete

This lets us analyse whether DataLab affects how you feel!

::: {.callout-note}
## Within-Subjects Design
Each person serves as their own control — a powerful experimental approach.
:::

## Form Your Project Groups

By the end of Thursday, form groups of [**3-4 students**]{.inverse-box}.

Your group will:

- Work together on the **research project**
- Conduct labs together from **Week 16**
- Generate data for the **Research Report**

## Choose Wisely
Pick people you can reliably meet with outside class.
:::
